text:
matt: Quick flag — running a saved search under org=acme-prod surfaced rows from org=beta-inc in the console.

alina: uh oh. Seen only in UI? or via API too?

matt: Only from Console UI path. Repro in incognito. Steps:
1) Insights -> Saved searches
2) Click "Q3 revenue anomalies" (saved_id=abc123)
3) Observe mixed org rows

matt: network capture:
```
GET /internal/console/search?saved_id=abc123&org=acme-prod
200 OK
Response: { items: [..., {org_id: "beta-inc", id: 789}, ...] }
```

cheyenne: pinging @eng-runtime and @eng-platform. @alina did we change prefetch affinity header handling in the canary last night?

alina: yes — we flipped PREFETCH_AFFINITY to prefer X-Org-ID header over session cookie for a gradual canary. rollout finished around 03:12Z.

sre-bot: deploy bot: rollout PREFETCH_AFFINITY header-canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (2026-03-21T03:12:02Z)

samir: sketch of root cause: writes (prefetch writer) use raw req.getHeader('X-Org-ID') as the affinity key string; reads (prefetch reader) call RequestContext.affinityKey() which normalizes ids (lowercase, strip prefixes). mismatch in normalization + fallback to cookie can lead to different redis keys.

olga: can you show an example redis key?

matt: found one:
```
saved_search:prefetch:X-Org-ID:acme-prod:abc123 -> { results: [...], cached_for_org: "beta-inc", written_at: "2026-03-21T03:14:10Z" }
```

cheyenne: that payload is alarming. suggests write used header-derived key but cached_for_org meta shows different owner.

alina: immediate mitigation: rolling back header-first canary and purging suspect keys. also adding a write-guard that requires header and cookie to match for 48h.

olga: starting a dry-run purge to enumerate keys created in the canary window:
```
redis-cli KEYS "saved_search:prefetch:*2026-03-21*" # dry run
```

sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-034 - console-prefetch-affinity-leak. Severity P2. On-call: infra-team.

matt: scope estimate: ~120 saved searches with mismatched cache entries. I'll attach trace and sample row ids to the incident.

samir: taking RCA ownership. next steps:
- grep for all affinityKey usages
- unify key derivation via RequestContext.affinityKey helper
- add unit + integration tests for concurrent multi-org requests
ETA: 6h for RCA, 24h for PR + tests.

cheyenne: also sweep other console prefetch consumers (quicknav, previews, hovercards). if they share the same cache prefix, they might be affected.

alina: postmortem checklist: missing cross-org fuzz tests on canary, insufficient write/read key invariants in code review. add rollout guard for future affinity feature flips.

matt: adding quick e2e to console CI to simulate concurrent users from different orgs hitting same saved search and asserting isolation.

samir: logging a follow-up ticket to change saved_search cache prefix to include a strong namespace hash based on normalized org id. will link here.

cheyenne: thanks all — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
